title: Chicken Hawaii Salad
description: Chicken Hawaii Salad is a refreshing Continental salad featuring tender chicken breast, crisp vegetables, sweet pineapple, and a creamy Hawaiian-inspired dressing. It is a colorful and light dish, perfect as an appetizer or healthy main course.

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: Freshly ground black pepper – ¼ tsp
Iceberg lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces – 1 cup
Red bell pepper, julienned – ½ cup
Red onion, thin rings – ¼ cup
Toasted cashews or almonds – ¼ cup (optional)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear chicken for 4–5 minutes on each side until golden brown and fully cooked (internal temperature 75°C / 165°F).
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice into thin strips or cubes.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Dressing
steps: In a bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, honey, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and apple cider vinegar.
Season with salt and white pepper.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Salad
steps: On a chilled plate, arrange iceberg and romaine lettuce as the base.
Layer bell pepper, cucumber, celery, onion, tomatoes, and pineapple.
Place chicken slices attractively on top.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finishing Touch
steps: Drizzle dressing evenly over the salad or serve in a small ramekin on the side.
Sprinkle toasted nuts for extra crunch.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and fresh mint sprig for presentation.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as a light main course or appetizer.
Pair with crusty bread or garlic toast.
Accompany with a light white wine like Sauvignon Blanc or Chardonnay.

chefTips: Plate in layers so each ingredient is visible, not just tossed.
Use white or neutral-colored plates to make colors pop.
Chill salad plates before serving to keep freshness.
Sprinkle toasted cashews or almonds just before serving to retain their crunch.
